entries.description: A player completes an advancement. Has `player`.
entries.name: Advancement done

entries.description: An item is placed in an anvil and the result slot is being prepared. Has `player`.
entries.name: Anvil prepare

entries.description: A player swings their arm, for example when hitting air. Has `player`.
entries.name: Arm swing

entries.description: A player gets into a bed. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Bed enter

entries.description: A player gets out of a bed. Has `player`.
entries.name: Bed leave

entries.description: A bell is rung. Has `player` when a player rang it.
entries.name: Bell ring

entries.description: A block is broken. Has `player` (`<none>` when no player broke it). Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Block break

entries.description: A block is destroyed by fire. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Block burn

entries.description: A player starts hitting a block. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Block damage

entries.description: A broken block drops its items. Has `player`.
entries.name: Block drop

entries.description: A block is fertilized with bone meal. Has `player` when a player did it. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Block fertilize

entries.description: A crop or plant grows a stage. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Block growth

entries.description: A player places a block. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on place:
    add 1 to {placed::%player%}
entries.name: Block place

entries.description: A player edits a book and quill. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Book edit

entries.description: A player signs a book and quill. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Book sign

entries.description: A player walks into a SkBee bound. Has `player`.
entries.name: Bound enter

entries.description: A player walks out of a SkBee bound. Has `player`.
entries.name: Bound exit

entries.description: A brewing stand finishes brewing.
entries.name: Brewing complete

entries.description: A brewing stand uses blaze powder as fuel. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Brewing fuel

entries.description: A brewing stand starts brewing.
entries.name: Brewing start

entries.description: A message is broadcast to the whole server. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Broadcast

entries.description: A player catches a fish or axolotl in a bucket. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Bucket catch entity

entries.description: A player empties a bucket. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Bucket empty

entries.description: A player fills a bucket. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Bucket fill

entries.description: The server checks whether a block can be placed at a spot. Has `player`.
entries.name: Can build check

entries.description: A player sends a chat message. Has `player` and `message`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Chat

entries.description: A new chunk is generated.
entries.name: Chunk generate

entries.description: A chunk is unloaded.
entries.name: Chunk unload

entries.description: A player clicks air or a block. `with` checks the held item, `on` the clicked block, in any order. Has `clicked block` (also `event-block`). Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on right click with blaze rod:
    send "Whoosh!" to player
entries.name: Click

entries.description: An entity catches fire. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Combust

entries.description: Adds a script command. Entries: `permission:`, `description:` and the required `trigger:`. Argument types: `<text>`, `<number>`, `<player>`; `[ ]` makes one optional. New commands need a server restart.
entries.example:
command /greet <player> [<text>]:
    permission: greet
    trigger:
        send "%player% says hi!" to arg-1
entries.name: Command

entries.description: A player runs any command. `command` is the command name, `full command` the whole text without the slash. `cancel event` stops the command. With a name (`on command "home":`) it only runs for that command; a name with a space compares the full command.
entries.example:
on command:
    if command is "op":
        cancel event
        send "No." to player
entries.name: Command (event)

entries.description: A player connects, before they are fully logged in. Has `player`.
entries.name: Connect

entries.description: A player eats or drinks. Has `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on eat:
    send "yum" to player
entries.name: Consume

entries.description: A player crafts an item. Has `event-recipe`, `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on craft:
    send "crafted %event-item%" to player
entries.name: Craft

entries.description: A player or mob takes damage. `on damage of player` / `on damage of zombie` run for that victim type only. Has `damage` (settable), `damage cause`, `attacker` (a player or entity, `<none>` for falls and the like) and `victim`; `player` is `<none>` when the victim is a mob. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Damage

entries.description: A player dies. Has `player`, `victim`, `death message` (settable) and `attacker`: the last player or entity that hit them in the 5 seconds before, else `<none>`. Cancelling stops Pumpkin's death handling but leaves 0 health.
entries.example:
on death of player:
    broadcast "%player% died"
entries.name: Death

entries.description: A dispenser or dropper shoots out an item. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Dispense

entries.description: A player drops an item. Has `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Drop

entries.description: A thrown egg lands. Has `player` (the thrower).
entries.name: Egg throw

entries.description: A player boosts their elytra flight with a firework. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Elytra boost

entries.description: A player enchants an item at an enchanting table. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Enchant

entries.description: An item is placed in an enchanting table and the offers are shown. Has `player`.
entries.name: Enchant prepare

entries.description: Two animals breed. Has `player` when a player fed them.
entries.name: Entity breed

entries.description: An enderman, sheep, silverfish or falling block changes a block. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Entity change block

entries.description: An entity gets off another entity.
entries.name: Entity dismount

entries.description: An entity gets on another entity. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Entity mount

entries.description: A potion effect is added to, changed on or removed from an entity.
entries.name: Entity potion effect

entries.description: An entity shoots a bow or crossbow. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Entity shoot bow

entries.description: An entity turns into another, for example a villager struck by lightning. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Entity transform

entries.description: A player's experience changes. Has `player`.
entries.name: Experience change

entries.description: A player's experience pickup cooldown changes. Has `player`.
entries.name: Experience cooldown change

entries.description: An entity explodes, like a creeper or TNT. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Explode

entries.description: An explosive is about to explode, like a lit creeper. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Explosion prime

entries.description: A block fades away, like melting ice or snow. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Fade

entries.description: A firework rocket explodes. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Firework explode

entries.description: A player joins the server for the first time. Carve remembers who has joined in `first_join.txt` in its data folder. Has `player`.
entries.example:
on first join:
    broadcast "Welcome %player% to the server!"
entries.name: First join

entries.description: A player casts, reels in or catches something with a fishing rod. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Fishing

entries.description: A player starts or stops flying. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on flight toggle:
    send "wheee" to player
entries.name: Flight toggle

entries.description: Water or lava flows into a block. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Flow

entries.description: A block forms naturally, like snow or concrete. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Form

entries.description: A furnace starts burning a fuel item. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Fuel burn

entries.description: A player takes smelted items out of a furnace. Has `player`.
entries.name: Furnace item extract

entries.description: A player's game mode changes. Has `old gamemode`, `new gamemode` and `player`. `to creative` filters by the new mode. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on gamemode change to creative:
    send "creative on" to player
entries.name: Gamemode change

entries.description: An entity starts or stops gliding with an elytra. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Gliding state change

entries.description: A tree or big mushroom grows from a sapling. Has `player` when bone meal was used. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Grow

entries.description: A player harvests a block like sweet berries without breaking it. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Harvest block

entries.description: An entity regains health. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Heal

entries.description: A player makes a horse jump. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Horse jump

entries.description: A player's food level changes. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Hunger meter change

entries.description: A block catches fire. Has `player` when a player lit it. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Ignition

entries.description: A player clicks a slot in an open inventory, any window. Has `clicked slot`, `clicked item` and `click type`. Cancel it so players cannot take menu items.
entries.name: Inventory click

entries.description: A player closes an inventory. Cannot be cancelled.
entries.example:
on inventory close:
    send "Bye." to player
entries.name: Inventory close

entries.description: A player drags items across inventory slots. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Inventory drag

entries.description: A hopper or similar block moves an item between inventories. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Inventory item move

entries.description: A player opens an inventory. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Inventory open

entries.description: A hopper picks up an item from the ground. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Inventory pickup

entries.description: A player's tool or armour breaks from wear. Has `player`.
entries.name: Item break

entries.description: A player's tool or armour loses durability. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Item damage

entries.description: A dropped item despawns after lying on the ground. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Item despawn

entries.description: An item is repaired by the Mending enchantment. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Item mend

entries.description: Two dropped items merge into one stack. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Item merge

entries.description: A dropped item appears in the world. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Item spawn

entries.description: A player joins the server. Has `player`.
entries.example:
on join:
    send title "Welcome, %player%!" to player
entries.name: Join

entries.description: A player is kicked from the server. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Kick

entries.description: A player changes their client language. Has `player`.
entries.name: Language change

entries.description: A player leashes an entity. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Leash

entries.description: Leaves decay away from a tree. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Leaves decay

entries.description: A player's level changes. Has `old level`, `new level` and `player`. Cannot be cancelled.
entries.name: Level change

entries.description: Lightning strikes. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Lightning strike

entries.description: Runs after scripts load, and after every successful `/carve reload`. No `player`. Cannot be cancelled.
entries.name: Load

entries.description: Loot is generated for a chest or a killed entity. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Loot generate

entries.description: An animal enters love mode after being fed. Has `player` when a player fed it. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Love mode enter

entries.description: A mob spawns. Has `event-entity`, `event-location` and `spawn reason`. `of zombie` filters by entity type. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on spawn of zombie:
    broadcast "a zombie spawned"
entries.name: Mob spawn

entries.description: A player moves into another block (turning the head or moving inside a block does not count). `event-location` is where to, `past event-location` where from. Can be cancelled. Needs a server restart when the first `on move` script is added.
entries.name: Move

entries.description: A block of named constants, used as `{@name}` anywhere in the same file.
entries.example:
options:
    prefix: &8[&6Shop&8]&r
on join:
    send "{@prefix} Welcome" to player
entries.name: Options

entries.description: Runs on a timer counted in server ticks from plugin load. No `player`. A `wait` inside does not delay the next round.
entries.example:
every 5 minutes:
    broadcast "&eDon't forget to vote!"
entries.name: Periodic (every)

entries.description: A player picks up an item. Has `event-item` and `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on pick up:
    send "you got %event-item%" to player
entries.name: Pick up

entries.description: A piglin finishes bartering for gold. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Piglin barter

entries.description: A piston pushes out. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Piston extend

entries.description: A piston pulls back. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Piston retract

entries.description: Someone asks for the placeholder `%<prefix>_<identifier>%`. `the identifier` is the text after the prefix and `the prefix` is the prefix. Answer with `set the result to ...`; if nothing sets it, the placeholder stays as written. Without `for prefix` the trigger sees every placeholder that is not built in.
entries.name: Placeholder request

entries.description: A player presses or releases a movement key. Has `player`.
entries.name: Player input

entries.description: A player is teleported by a portal. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Portal

entries.description: A nether or end portal is created. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Portal create

entries.description: An entity walks into a portal block.
entries.name: Portal enter

entries.description: A projectile hits something. Has `event-location` and `hit player` (`<none>` when it hit something else). Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on projectile hit:
    strike lightning effect at event-location
entries.name: Projectile hit

entries.description: A player leaves. The player is already gone, so `%player%` works until the first `wait` but effects on them do nothing.
entries.example:
on quit:
    broadcast "%player% left the server"
entries.name: Quit

entries.description: A player unlocks a recipe. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Recipe discover

entries.description: A block's redstone power changes.
entries.name: Redstone

entries.description: A player accepts, declines or finishes loading a resource pack. Has `player`.
entries.name: Resource pack response

entries.description: A player respawns. Cannot be cancelled.
entries.example:
on respawn:
    send "Welcome back" to player
entries.name: Respawn

entries.description: An entity would die and a totem of undying may save it. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Resurrect attempt

entries.description: The server sends a player the list of commands for tab completion. Has `player`.
entries.name: Send command list

entries.description: A client pings the server from its server list.
entries.name: Server list ping

entries.description: A sheared sheep grows its wool back. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Sheep regrow wool

entries.description: An entity launches a projectile. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Shoot

entries.description: A player writes on a sign. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Sign change

entries.description: A slime or magma cube splits into smaller ones. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Slime split

entries.description: A furnace finishes smelting an item. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Smelt

entries.description: A player starts or stops sneaking. State conditions show the state before the change. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Sneak toggle

entries.description: A world's spawn point changes.
entries.name: Spawn change

entries.description: A sponge soaks up water. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Sponge absorb

entries.description: A block spreads, like grass, mycelium or fire. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Spread

entries.description: A player starts or stops sprinting. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on sprint toggle:
    send "zoom" to player
entries.name: Sprint toggle

entries.description: A furnace starts smelting an item.
entries.name: Start smelt

entries.description: A player swaps the main hand and off hand items. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on swap hand items:
    cancel event
entries.name: Swap hand items

entries.description: An entity starts or stops swimming. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Swim toggle

entries.description: A player tames an animal. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Tame

entries.description: A mob picks or drops a target. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Target

entries.description: A player is teleported. `event-location` is the target, `past event-location` the start. Can be cancelled.
entries.example:
on teleport:
    send "Zoom!" to player
entries.name: Teleport

entries.description: A player switches their held hotbar slot. Has `player`. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Tool change

entries.description: A leash comes off an entity. Has `player` when a player removed it.
entries.name: Unleash

entries.description: A vault block picks the item it shows. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Vault display item

entries.description: A vehicle bumps into a block or entity.
entries.name: Vehicle collision

entries.description: A boat or minecart is placed. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Vehicle create

entries.description: A boat or minecart takes damage. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Vehicle damage

entries.description: A boat or minecart is destroyed. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Vehicle destroy

entries.description: An entity gets into a vehicle. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Vehicle enter

entries.description: An entity gets out of a vehicle. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Vehicle exit

entries.description: A vehicle moves.
entries.name: Vehicle move

entries.description: A villager gains or loses a profession. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Villager career change

entries.description: The weather in a world changes. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Weather change

entries.description: A player arrived in another world. `event-world` is the new world, `past event-world` the old one.
entries.example:
on world change:
    send "Now in %event-world%" to player
entries.name: World change

entries.description: A world is initialized, before it loads.
entries.name: World init

entries.description: A world is loaded.
entries.name: World load

entries.description: A world is saved.
entries.name: World save

entries.description: A world is unloaded. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: World unload

entries.description: A zombie breaks down a door. Can be cancelled.
entries.name: Zombie break door

entries.description: Adds to a number variable, or appends to a list (`add "x" and "y" to {list::*}`).
entries.example: add 1 to {joins::%uuid of player%}
entries.name: Add

entries.description: Adds items to, or takes up to that many items from, a player's inventory.
entries.example: remove 2 diamonds from player
entries.name: Add or remove items

entries.description: Gives a potion effect. The number is the tier (default 1); the time defaults to 15 seconds.
entries.example: apply potion of speed 2 to player for 10 seconds
entries.name: Apply potion effect

entries.description: Bans a player or name, or their IP, with an optional reason.
entries.example: ban "Alex" because of "cheating"
entries.name: Ban
patterns: ban ip %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% by ip [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]
ban %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]

entries.description: Breaks a block and updates its neighbours. No drops.
entries.example: break targeted block of player
entries.name: Break block

entries.description: Sends a message to every online player.
entries.example: broadcast "&e%player% joined!"
entries.name: Broadcast

entries.description: Sets how long an entity stays on fire, used as `set burn time of player to 5 seconds`.
entries.name: Burn time

entries.description: Stops the event. Works before the first `wait`. Some events cannot be cancelled; using it there is a load error.
entries.example:
on chat:
    cancel event
entries.name: Cancel event

entries.description: Changes the damage of the hit in `on damage` (never below 0). Only a change before the first `wait` reaches the server.
entries.name: Change damage

entries.description: Changes total experience points. Never below 0.
entries.example: give player 10 xp
entries.name: Change experience

entries.description: Changes the food level, 0 to 20.
entries.example: remove 2 from food level of player
entries.name: Change food level

entries.description: Sets, raises or lowers health (20 = 10 hearts). Values are kept between 0 and max health; 0 kills.
entries.example: set health of player to 10
entries.name: Change health

entries.description: Sets, adds or removes whole levels. Never below 0.
entries.example: give player 3 levels
entries.name: Change level

entries.description: Changes progress to the next level, kept between 0 and 1.
entries.example: set level progress of player to 0.5
entries.name: Change level progress

entries.description: Changes max health. Lowering it also lowers current health when needed.
entries.example: set max health of player to 40
entries.name: Change max health

entries.description: Changes saturation, 0 to 20.
entries.example: set saturation of player to 5
entries.name: Change saturation

entries.description: Empties the player's inventory, armor and off hand included, or the open menu.
entries.example: clear player's inventory
entries.name: Clear inventory

entries.description: Loads, but does nothing yet: plugin API v0.1 has no call to close a window. A warning is logged.
entries.example: close player's inventory
entries.name: Close inventory

entries.description: Sets or resets where a player's compass points.
entries.name: Compass target

entries.description: Transfers a player to another server, on port 25565 unless one is given.
entries.name: Connect to server

entries.description: Copies a variable, including every item of a list, into another variable.
entries.name: Copy variable

entries.description: Makes an explosion that breaks blocks like TNT. Default force 3, max 100.
entries.example: create explosion of force 3 at player
entries.name: Create explosion
patterns: create [an] explosion [(of force|with power) %number%] [with fire] at %location%

entries.description: Creates a world (or loads it when it exists) or unloads one. Names are letters, digits, `_`, `-` and `.`. A refusal from the server is a script error with the reason.
entries.example:
on join:
    create world "arena" with environment nether
entries.name: Create, load or unload a world

entries.description: Removes poison from a player.
entries.name: Cure poison

entries.description: Shows or hides the name tag of an entity.
entries.name: Custom name visibility

entries.description: Hurts the player with generic damage.
entries.example: damage player by 2
entries.name: Damage

entries.description: Replaces the death message in `on death`. Colors work. Only a change before the first `wait` reaches the server.
entries.name: Death message

entries.description: Deletes a variable, or a whole list with `{list::*}`.
entries.example: delete {home::%uuid of player%}
entries.name: Delete

entries.description: Removes a metadata value from an entity or block. Metadata is lost on restart.
entries.name: Delete metadata

entries.description: Removes a persistent data value from an entity, block or item.
entries.name: Delete persistent data

entries.description: Makes a player get off whatever they are riding, or throws off their passengers.
entries.name: Dismount

entries.description: Sets or resets a player's display name. Color codes work.
entries.example: set display name of player to "&6Boss"
entries.name: Display name

entries.description: Puts an item into the matching armour or hand slot of a player.
entries.name: Equip

entries.description: Runs a server command as the console, right after the script finishes.
entries.example: execute console command "say hi"
entries.name: Execute console command

entries.description: Sets a player's exhaustion, used as `set exhaustion of player to 2`.
entries.name: Exhaustion

entries.description: Leaves the innermost loop, or skips to its next round.
entries.name: Exit loop / continue

entries.description: Puts out a burning player.
entries.name: Extinguish

entries.description: Sets how far a player has fallen, used as `set fall distance of player to 0`.
entries.name: Fall distance

entries.description: Fills food level and saturation to 20, or adds to the food level.
entries.example: feed player
entries.name: Feed

entries.description: Keeps the elements of a list for which every condition below holds. `input` is the element and `input index` its index.
entries.example:
set {_l::*} to 1, 2, 3, 4
filter {_l::*} to match:
    input > 2
entries.name: Filter section

entries.description: Lets a player fly or takes flying away.
entries.name: Flight
patterns: make %player% (stop flying|not fly|stop fly|unable to fly)

entries.description: Respawns a dead player without them clicking the button.
entries.name: Force respawn

entries.description: Sets how long a player has been freezing in powder snow.
entries.name: Freeze time

entries.description: Gives items to a player. Item names are checked when the script loads.
entries.example: give 2 diamonds to player
entries.name: Give item

entries.description: Turns the glowing outline of an entity on or off.
entries.name: Glowing state

entries.description: Turns gravity for an entity on or off.
entries.name: Gravity state

entries.description: Heals to full health, or adds that much health up to the max.
entries.example: heal player by 4
entries.name: Heal

entries.description: Hides a player from everyone or from one player.
entries.name: Hide player

entries.description: Runs the indented block when the condition is true. A condition on its own line stops the trigger when false.
entries.name: If / else

entries.description: Sets a player on fire (default 5 seconds) or puts the fire out.
entries.example: ignite player for 5 seconds
entries.name: Ignite / extinguish

entries.description: Makes a player invisible or visible again.
entries.name: Invisibility

entries.description: Makes a player immune to damage or vulnerable again.
entries.name: Invulnerability

entries.description: Sets or resets the cooldown of an item type for a player.
entries.name: Item cooldown

entries.description: Changes the message shown when a player joins. Use in `on join`.
entries.name: Join message

entries.description: Kicks a player, with an optional reason.
entries.example: kick player due to "bad vibes"
entries.name: Kick
patterns: kick %object% [(by reason of|because of|because|on account of|due to|for|with reason) %text%]

entries.description: Kills the player.
entries.example: kill player
entries.name: Kill

entries.description: Pushes a player away from or toward a location, with an optional strength.
entries.name: Knockback

entries.description: Writes a line to the server log, or to a log file in the plugin folder.
entries.name: Log

entries.description: Turns a player to face a location.
entries.name: Look at

entries.description: Runs the block for each item, value or online player. Gives `loop-value`, `loop-index` or `loop-player`.
entries.example:
loop all players:
    send "Restart in 1 minute" to loop-player
entries.name: Loop list

entries.description: Runs the block N times. `loop-number` counts from 1.
entries.example:
loop 3 times:
    send "Round %loop-number%" to player
entries.name: Loop times

entries.description: Runs a command as a player (their permissions apply) or the console. A leading `/` is ignored. Without `by` it runs as the console.
entries.example: make player execute command "/spawn"
entries.name: Make execute command

entries.description: Makes a player send a chat message, or run a command when the text starts with `/`.
entries.name: Make say

entries.description: Gives or takes operator status, through the server's own command. Works for offline names.
entries.example: op player
entries.name: Op / deop

entries.description: Opens the book a player holds in their main or off hand.
entries.name: Open book
patterns: open [the] book in [the] off hand to %player%

entries.description: Opens an empty chest menu with 1 to 6 rows. Fill it with `set slot`.
entries.example: open chest with 3 rows named "Shop" to player
entries.name: Open chest menu

entries.description: Shows particles. The name is the Minecraft particle id with spaces and is checked at load. Count defaults to 1, max 1000.
entries.example: show 20 happy villager particles at player with spread 0.5
entries.name: Particles

entries.description: Plays a sound id to a player, or at a location for everyone. Volume 0 or more, pitch 0 to 2.
entries.example: play sound "block.note_block.pling" with volume 0.5 and pitch 2 to player
entries.name: Play sound

entries.description: Poisons a player, for 15 seconds unless a duration is given.
entries.name: Poison

entries.description: Changes how long a player can stay underwater before drowning.
entries.name: Remaining air

entries.description: Subtracts from a number variable, or removes every equal item from a list.
entries.example: remove 5 from {coins::%uuid of player%}
entries.name: Remove

entries.description: Removes one potion effect or all of them.
entries.example: remove all potion effects from player
entries.name: Remove potion effects

entries.description: Replaces text inside a text variable. Matching is exact and case sensitive.
entries.example:
set {_t} to "a-b-c"
replace all "-" with " " in {_t}
entries.name: Replace text

entries.description: Clears the title a player is seeing.
entries.name: Reset title

entries.description: Sets where a player respawns after death.
entries.name: Respawn location

entries.description: Gives back a value from a function. Its type must match the return type.
entries.example:
function double(n: number) :: number:
    return {_n} * 2
entries.name: Return

entries.description: Shows a hidden player again to everyone or to one player.
entries.name: Reveal player

entries.description: Makes a player ride another player.
entries.name: Ride

entries.description: Saves all worlds to disk.
entries.name: Save worlds

entries.description: Shows text just above the hotbar.
entries.example: send action bar "&7Coins: %{coins::%uuid of player%}%" to player
entries.name: Send action bar

entries.description: Sends a text component (with hover and click parts) to players or the whole server.
entries.name: Send component

entries.description: Sends a message. Without `to` it goes to whoever started the trigger. `to console` writes to the server log. Color codes work.
entries.example: send "&aHello %player%!" to player
entries.name: Send message

entries.description: Asks a player to download a resource pack, optionally checked against a SHA-1 hash.
entries.name: Send resource pack

entries.description: Shows a big title, with an optional subtitle, on the player's screen.
entries.example: send title "Welcome" with subtitle "to the server" to player
entries.name: Send title

entries.description: Stores a value in a variable. `set {list::*} to a, b and c` replaces a whole list.
entries.example: set {spawn} to location of player
entries.name: Set

entries.description: Places a block of that type. Any block form works on the left.
entries.example: set block below player to diamond block
entries.name: Set block

entries.description: Changes the game mode. The mode can be a word, text, a number 0 to 3 or a short form (`s`, `c`, `a`, `sp`).
entries.example: set gamemode of player to creative
entries.name: Set gamemode

entries.description: Stores a metadata value on an entity or block. Metadata is lost on restart.
entries.name: Set metadata

entries.description: Stores a value on an entity, block or item that survives restarts.
entries.name: Set persistent data
patterns: set persistent data value %text% of %object% to %object%

entries.description: Puts an item in a slot (counted from 0). `air` empties it. `player's current inventory` is the open Carve menu.
entries.example: set slot 4 of player's current inventory to diamond
entries.name: Set slot

entries.description: Sorts a list in place. Numbers sort by value, before text.
entries.example:
set {_n::*} to 3, 1 and 2
sort {_n::*}
entries.name: Sort list

entries.description: Spawns an entity and runs the body; `event-entity` is the new entity.
entries.example:
spawn a zombie at player:
    set name of event-entity to "Bob"
entries.name: Spawn section

entries.description: Makes a player start or stop sprinting.
entries.name: Sprint

entries.description: Ends the whole trigger, or a function that returns nothing.
entries.example:
if player does not have permission "vip":
    stop
entries.name: Stop

entries.description: Shuts the server down.
entries.name: Stop server

entries.description: Stops one sound or all sounds for a player.
entries.example: stop all sounds for player
entries.name: Stop sound

entries.description: Strikes a real bolt. With `effect` it is only the flash and sound.
entries.example: strike lightning effect at player
entries.name: Strike lightning

entries.description: Turns off a kind of compiler warning for the script, or for the next lines with `locally`.
entries.name: Suppress warnings
patterns: [locally] suppress (conflict|conjunction|missing conjunction|variable save|variable saved|deprecation|deprecated syntax|unreachable code|empty script) (warning|warnings)

entries.description: Plays the hand swing animation of a player.
entries.name: Swing hand

entries.description: Sets or resets the name shown in the tab list.
entries.example: set tab list name of player to "&a[VIP] %player%"
entries.name: Tab list name
patterns: set tab list name of %object% to %text%

entries.description: Sets where a player is sorted in the tab list.
entries.name: Tab list priority

entries.description: Teleports the player to coordinates in their current world.
entries.example: teleport player to 0, 64, 0
entries.name: Teleport

entries.description: Teleports the player to a location. A location without a world keeps the player in their world.
entries.example: teleport player to location(0, 64, 0, world "world")
entries.name: Teleport to location

entries.description: Flips a boolean variable between true and false.
entries.name: Toggle

entries.description: Lifts a ban or an IP ban.
entries.example: unban "Alex"
entries.name: Unban

entries.description: Pauses the run without blocking the server. A timespan is rounded to the nearest tick.
entries.example:
wait 5 seconds
send "5 seconds later" to player
entries.name: Wait

entries.description: Runs the block while the condition holds. Checked before every round.
entries.name: While loop

entries.description: Joins conditions. Brackets group them.
entries.example:
if player is sneaking and player is on the ground:
    send "crouched" to player
entries.name: And / or

entries.description: Checks a block's type. False when the block cannot be read.
entries.example:
if block below player is grass block or dirt:
    send "soft ground" to player
entries.name: Block is type

entries.description: Whether an animal is old enough and ready to breed.
entries.name: Can breed

entries.description: Whether a player is allowed to build at a location.
entries.name: Can build

entries.description: Whether the player may fly. Follows the game mode (creative and spectator).
entries.example:
if player can fly:
    send "you can fly" to player
entries.name: Can fly

entries.description: Whether a player's inventory has room for an item.
entries.name: Can hold

entries.description: Whether a player picks up items from the ground.
entries.name: Can pick up items

entries.description: Whether a player can see another player, i.e. they are not hidden from them.
entries.name: Can see

entries.description: Whether a player's chat settings show messages, or chat colours.
entries.name: Can see chat

entries.description: True with that percent chance.
entries.example:
if chance of 10%:
    give diamond to player
entries.name: Chance

entries.description: Compares numbers, timespans or dates.
entries.example:
if health of player < 6:
    send "Careful!" to player
entries.name: Compare numbers

entries.description: Whether an entity's name tag is shown.
entries.name: Custom name visible

entries.description: Whether a date is later or earlier than now.
entries.name: Date in future or past

entries.description: Whether a text ends with another. Case is ignored.
entries.name: Ends with

entries.description: Whether the current event has been cancelled.
entries.name: Event is cancelled

entries.description: Whether a mob has its AI turned on.
entries.name: Has AI

entries.description: Whether an enderman has been looked at by a player.
entries.name: Has been stared at

entries.description: Whether a player has text filtering turned on in their client.
entries.name: Has chat filtering

entries.description: Whether a player sees their own weather instead of the world's.
entries.name: Has client weather

entries.description: Whether an item has custom model data.
entries.name: Has custom model data
patterns: %player% (doesn't|does not|don't|do not) have [a] custom model data

entries.description: Whether the sign at a location has glowing text.
entries.name: Has glowing text

entries.description: Whether the player has at least that many of an item.
entries.example:
if player has 3 diamonds:
    send "rich" to player
entries.name: Has item

entries.description: Whether an item type is on cooldown for a player.
entries.name: Has item cooldown

entries.description: Whether an entity can see another entity with nothing in between.
entries.name: Has line of sight
patterns: %object% (doesn't|does not|don't|do not) have [a] [direct] line of sight (to|of) %object%

entries.description: Checks a permission node.
entries.example:
if player has permission "vip":
    send "Hi VIP" to player
entries.name: Has permission

entries.description: Whether the player has a potion effect.
entries.example:
if player has potion effect speed:
    send "zoom" to player
entries.name: Has potion effect

entries.description: Whether a player has a server resource pack loaded.
entries.name: Has resource pack

entries.description: Whether the player's inventory holds the item.
entries.example:
if player's inventory contains 2 diamonds:
    send "ok" to player
entries.name: Inventory contains

entries.description: Whether a value, usually `sender`, is a player.
entries.example:
if sender is a player:
    send "hi" to sender
entries.name: Is a player

entries.description: Whether a player is alive or dead.
entries.name: Is alive

entries.description: Whether a text has only letters and digits.
entries.name: Is alphanumeric

entries.description: Parses, but is always false for now: Pumpkin gives plugins no way to read the ban list.
entries.example:
if "Alex" is banned:
    send "banned"
entries.name: Is banned

entries.description: Whether a number is in a range, both ends included.
entries.example:
if level of player is between 10 and 20:
    send "mid level" to player
entries.name: Is between

entries.description: Always false for now: the plugin API has no shield state.
entries.example:
if player is blocking:
    send "blocked" to player
entries.name: Is blocking

entries.description: Whether a player is on fire.
entries.name: Is burning

entries.description: Whether a number divides evenly by another.
entries.name: Is divisible

entries.description: Whether an item can be eaten.
entries.name: Is edible

entries.description: Whether a text, list or inventory has nothing in it.
entries.name: Is empty

entries.description: Whether an item has any enchantment, or a given one.
entries.name: Is enchanted

entries.description: Compares two values. Text compares without case; `x is a or b` checks several options.
entries.example:
command /toggle <text>:
    trigger:
        if arg is "on" or "yes":
            send "enabled"
entries.name: Is equal

entries.description: Whether an item survives fire and lava, like netherite.
entries.name: Is fire resistant

entries.description: Whether a block type can catch fire.
entries.name: Is flammable

entries.description: Whether the player is flying, tracked from flight toggle events.
entries.example:
if player is flying:
    send "up there" to player
entries.name: Is flying

entries.description: Whether a player is fully frozen in powder snow.
entries.name: Is frozen

entries.description: Whether an item can be burned in a furnace.
entries.name: Is fuel

entries.description: Whether a player is flying with an elytra.
entries.name: Is gliding

entries.description: Whether a player has a glowing outline.
entries.name: Is glowing

entries.description: Checks the player's game mode.
entries.example:
if player is in creative:
    send "creative!" to player
entries.name: Is in gamemode

entries.description: Whether an entity is in water or lava.
entries.name: Is in liquid

entries.description: Whether an entity or location is in a given world.
entries.name: Is in world

entries.description: Whether a potion effect type is instant, like instant health.
entries.name: Is instant

entries.description: Whether a player is invisible.
entries.name: Is invisible

entries.description: Whether a player takes no damage.
entries.name: Is invulnerable

entries.description: Whether a chunk or world is loaded.
entries.name: Is loaded

entries.description: Whether a value is of a given type, like `entity type`.
entries.name: Is of type

entries.description: Whether the player stands on the ground.
entries.example:
if player is not on the ground:
    send "in the air" to player
entries.name: Is on ground

entries.description: Whether a player is online.
entries.name: Is online

entries.description: Whether the player's permission level is above zero.
entries.example:
if player is op:
    send "hi admin" to player
entries.name: Is op

entries.description: Whether a block type can be walked through, like tall grass.
entries.name: Is passable

entries.description: Whether a player has the poison effect.
entries.name: Is poisoned

entries.description: Whether a player is riding an entity or vehicle.
entries.name: Is riding

entries.description: Whether the bell at a location is ringing.
entries.name: Is ringing

entries.description: Whether a command was defined by a script.
entries.name: Is script command

entries.description: Whether the beehive at a location is calmed by a campfire below it.
entries.name: Is sedated

entries.description: Whether a variable or value has a value. A list is set when it has at least one item.
entries.example:
if {home::%uuid of player%} is not set:
    send "No home yet" to player
entries.name: Is set

entries.description: Whether a sheep or snow golem has been sheared.
entries.name: Is sheared

entries.description: Whether an entity makes no sounds.
entries.name: Is silent

entries.description: Whether the player is in a bed.
entries.example:
if player is sleeping:
    send "zzz" to player
entries.name: Is sleeping

entries.description: Whether the player is sneaking.
entries.example:
if player is sneaking:
    send "sneaky" to player
entries.name: Is sneaking

entries.description: Whether a block type is solid.
entries.name: Is solid

entries.description: Whether the player is sprinting.
entries.example:
if player is sprinting:
    send "fast" to player
entries.name: Is sprinting

entries.description: Whether the player is swimming.
entries.example:
if player is swimming:
    send "splash" to player
entries.name: Is swimming

entries.description: Checks a block, item or item name against a vanilla tag. An unknown tag logs a warning and the check is false.
entries.name: Is tagged

entries.description: Whether a block or item is in a Minecraft tag, like `minecraft:logs`.
entries.name: Is tagged

entries.description: Whether a value, usually `sender`, is the console.
entries.example:
if sender is console:
    stop
entries.name: Is the console

entries.description: Whether a block type lets light through.
entries.name: Is transparent

entries.description: Whether an entity still exists in the world.
entries.name: Is valid

entries.description: Whether an entity is in water or rain.
entries.name: Is wet

entries.description: Whether a location lies in the box between two corners.
entries.name: Is within area

entries.description: Whether a location or entity is within a distance of another.
entries.name: Is within radius

entries.description: Whether a text contains or fully matches a regular expression.
entries.name: Matches regex

entries.description: Whether players can hurt each other, server-wide or in a world.
entries.name: PvP enabled

entries.description: Whether respawn anchors can be used in a world.
entries.name: Respawn anchors work
patterns: respawn anchors (don't|do not|doesn't|does not) work in %world%

entries.description: Whether a script file is loaded.
entries.name: Script is loaded

entries.description: Whether a text starts with another. Case is ignored.
entries.name: Starts with

entries.description: Whether a text has a piece in it, or a list has an item. Case is ignored.
entries.name: Text or list contains

entries.description: Is the world or chunk loaded right now. Chunks answer false when the server cannot tell.
entries.name: World or chunk is loaded

entries.description: A date relative to now, or the time since or until a date.
entries.example:
if time since {last::%uuid of player%} < 30 seconds:
    send "slow down" to player
entries.name: Ago / later

entries.description: A command argument, counted from 1. Its type comes from the command line.
entries.example:
command /pay <player> <number>:
    trigger:
        send "Paying %arg-2% to %arg-1%"
entries.name: Argument

entries.description: Math with the usual order. Works on timespans and dates too. Dividing by zero is a runtime error.
entries.example: set {_half} to (5 + 3) / 2
entries.name: Arithmetic

entries.description: A block position. `targeted block` looks up to 100 blocks.
entries.example: set {_b} to block below player
entries.name: Block

entries.description: The block type as an item, like `stone`.
entries.example: send "You stand on %type of block below player%." to player
entries.name: Block type

entries.description: A true or false value.
entries.example: set {_on} to true
entries.name: Boolean

entries.description: The chat text. Only in `on chat`.
entries.example:
on chat:
    send "You said: %message%" to player
entries.name: Chat message

entries.description: A chunk value, or the list of chunks in a square radius (at most 32).
entries.example:
on join:
    set {_c::*} to chunks in radius 1 around player
    send "%size of {_c::*}%"
entries.name: Chunk

entries.description: In click events: the clicked block type as an item (`air` for air).
entries.name: Clicked block

entries.description: Turns color codes and tags into `§` codes, or strips them all.
entries.example: set {_plain} to uncolored "<red>Hello"
entries.name: Colored / uncolored

entries.description: One coordinate of a location or player.
entries.example: send "You are at y %y of player%" to player
entries.name: Coordinates

entries.description: In `on damage` and `on death`: the damage of the hit, the attacking player or entity and the hurt player or entity. `attacker is a zombie`, `type of attacker` and `name of attacker` (the custom name, else the type) work on entities.
entries.name: Damage values

entries.description: The first value, or the second when the first is not set.
entries.example: send "Coins: %{coins::%uuid of player%} ? 0%" to player
entries.name: Default value

entries.description: The display or tab list name, falling back to the account name.
entries.example: send "Hi %display name of player%" to player
entries.name: Display and tab list name

entries.description: The distance between two locations or players.
entries.example: set {_d} to distance between player and location(0, 64, 0)
entries.name: Distance

entries.description: In `on mob spawn`: the entity type as text, and why it spawned.
entries.name: Event entity

entries.description: The item of a drop, pick up, consume or craft event.
entries.example:
on drop:
    send "dropped %event-item%" to player
entries.name: Event item

entries.description: The location of a projectile hit or mob spawn.
entries.example:
on projectile hit:
    strike lightning effect at event-location
entries.name: Event location

entries.description: In `on craft`: the recipe id without `minecraft:`.
entries.example:
on craft:
    send "%event-recipe%" to player
entries.name: Event recipe

entries.description: The items for which the test holds. `input` is the item being tested.
entries.example:
set {_n::*} to 1, 5 and 9
set {_big::*} to {_n::*} where [input > 2]
entries.name: Filtered list

entries.description: Food level and saturation, 0 to 20.
entries.example:
if food level of player < 6:
    send "You are hungry." to player
entries.name: Food and saturation

entries.description: A date as text, Java-style format letters. Default `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`.
entries.example: send "It is %now formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"%" to player
entries.name: Formatted date

entries.description: The player's game mode as text.
entries.example: send "%gamemode of player%" to player
entries.name: Gamemode

entries.description: Current or max health (20 = 10 hearts).
entries.example: send "%health of player% / %max health of player%" to player
entries.name: Health

entries.description: In `on projectile hit`: the player that was hit, or `<none>`.
entries.name: Hit player

entries.description: Where a text appears, from 1. 0 when not found. Case sensitive.
entries.example: send "%index of "l" in "hello"%" to player
entries.name: Index of

entries.description: In `on inventory click`: the slot number, the item in it and the kind of click.
entries.example:
on inventory click:
    send "%click type% on %clicked slot%" to player
entries.name: Inventory click values

entries.description: The item in a slot, unset when empty. Slots count from 0.
entries.example: set {_item} to slot 3 of player's current inventory
entries.name: Inventory slot

entries.description: A Minecraft item id with spaces, optionally with an amount. Checked at load.
entries.example: give 16 oak logs to player
entries.name: Item

entries.description: One text from a list. Unset items are skipped.
entries.example:
set {_l::*} to "a" and "b"
send join {_l::*} with ", " to player
entries.name: Join list

entries.description: The number of characters.
entries.example: send "%length of "hello"%" to player
entries.name: Length

entries.description: Whole levels, total experience points, or progress to the next level (0 to 1).
entries.example: send "You are level %level of player%" to player
entries.name: Level and experience

entries.description: Items of a list by position, at random, or its indices.
entries.example: send "%random element of {_l::*}%" to player
entries.name: List elements

entries.description: Several values in a row. Used with `set`, `add`, `remove` and `loop`.
entries.example: set {_colors::*} to "red", "green" and "blue"
entries.name: List literal

entries.description: A point in a world. Without a world, a teleport keeps the player in theirs.
entries.example: set {spawn} to location of player
entries.name: Location

entries.description: Values of the current loop: the item, the player, the list index, the count or the round number.
entries.example:
loop 3 times:
    send "%loop-number%" to player
entries.name: Loop values

entries.description: The blocks or items in a vanilla tag such as "logs", or the tags a block or item belongs to. The tag list is built in.
entries.example:
on join:
    set {_l::*} to minecraft block tag "logs"
    send "%size of {_l::*}%"
entries.name: Minecraft tag

entries.description: The player's name as text.
entries.example: set {owner} to name of player
entries.name: Name

entries.description: A line break, text without outer spaces, or text backwards.
entries.example: send "line one%nl%line two" to player
entries.name: Newline, trimmed, reversed

entries.description: The current date (UTC), a date from a unix timestamp in seconds, or the timestamp of a date.
entries.example: set {last::%uuid of player%} to now
entries.name: Now and unix dates

entries.description: A number like `5` or `-2.5`. Prints at most 4 decimals.
entries.example: set {_a} to 10
entries.name: Number

entries.description: In `on gamemode change`: the mode before and after.
entries.example:
on gamemode change:
    send "%old gamemode% to %new gamemode%" to player
entries.name: Old and new gamemode

entries.description: In `on level change`: the level before and after.
entries.example:
on level change:
    send "now level %new level%" to player
entries.name: Old and new level

entries.description: The value of an option from the file's `options:` block.
entries.example:
options:
    price: 25
on join:
    send "That costs {@price} coins." to player
entries.name: Option

entries.description: Replaces every `%name%` placeholder in the text. Write `%%name%%` in a script string, because `%%` is a literal percent sign there. Unknown placeholders stay as written.
entries.example: send parse placeholders in "Hi %%player_name%%, %%server_online%% online" for player
entries.name: Parse placeholders

entries.description: The number in a text, or `<none>` if it isn't one.
entries.example: set {_n} to "42" parsed as number
entries.name: Parsed as number

entries.description: The player's ping in milliseconds, or their IP address.
entries.example: send "Ping: %ping of player% ms" to player
entries.name: Ping and IP

entries.description: Value of one placeholder (no percent signs), like `"player_name"`, `"server_online"`, `"carve_var_coins"` or one a script defines. The player defaults to the event's player. Unknown placeholders give `<none>`.
entries.example: send placeholder "player_health" for player
entries.name: Placeholder

entries.description: Values inside `on placeholder request`. `the identifier` and `the prefix` are read only; `set the result to ...` answers the request.
entries.example:
on placeholder request for prefix "x":
    set the result to "you asked for %the identifier%"
entries.name: Placeholder request values

entries.description: The player of the event, or who ran the command. `<none>` when offline or for the console.
entries.example: send "Hi %player%" to player
entries.name: Player

entries.description: A random whole number (both ends included) or decimal number.
entries.example: set {_roll} to random integer between 1 and 6
entries.name: Random number

entries.description: Casts a thin ray and keeps the result in a variable. The hit is the nearer of the first block and the first entity. From a location, give a direction.
entries.example:
on join:
    set {_r} to ray trace from player with max distance 50
    send "you look at %hit block of {_r}%"
entries.name: Ray trace
patterns: ray trace from %player|location% [in direction %vector%] [with max distance %number%] [including fluids] [ignoring blocks|entities|fluids]

entries.description: A new text with matches replaced.
entries.example: set {_t} to "a-b" with all "-" replaced with " "
entries.name: Replaced text

entries.description: Who started the trigger (a player or the console), the console itself, or the player.
entries.example: send "hello" to sender
entries.name: Sender

entries.description: The number of direct items of a list.
entries.example: send "%size of {warps::*}% warps" to player
entries.name: Size of list

entries.description: A reordered copy of a list.
entries.example:
set {_n::*} to 3, 1 and 2
set {_s::*} to sorted {_n::*}
entries.name: Sorted, reversed, shuffled

entries.description: A list from a text. Works in `set {x::*} to` and `loop`.
entries.example: set {_parts::*} to split "a,b,c" at ","
entries.name: Split text

entries.description: Pieces of a text. Positions count from 1.
entries.example: send "%first 3 characters of "hello"%" to player
entries.name: Substring

entries.description: Numbers from a list. Non-numbers are skipped.
entries.example:
set {_n::*} to 1, 5 and 9
send "%sum of {_n::*}%" to player
entries.name: Sum, average, min, max

entries.description: Text in double quotes. `%...%` inserts a value, `%%` is a percent sign, `""` a quote.
entries.example: send "Sale: 50%% off for %player%" to player
entries.name: Text

entries.description: Changes letter case.
entries.example: send "%capitalized "steve"%" to player
entries.name: Text case

entries.description: A length of time, like `1 hour and 30 seconds`.
entries.example: set {delay} to 1 minute and 30 seconds
entries.name: Timespan

entries.description: One part of a timespan, or the whole span in that unit with `total`.
entries.example:
set {_t} to 1 hour and 30 minutes
send "%total minutes of {_t}%" to player
entries.name: Timespan parts

entries.description: The item in the main hand, `air` when empty.
entries.example:
if tool of player is diamond sword:
    send "nice sword" to player
entries.name: Tool

entries.description: The player's UUID as text. Good for variable names.
entries.example: add 1 to {joins::%uuid of player%}
entries.name: UUID

entries.description: A global (saved) or local (`_`) variable. `<none>` when never set.
entries.example: set {_x} to {coins::%uuid of player%}
entries.name: Variable

entries.description: A world by name, or the world of a location or player.
entries.example:
if world of player is "world":
    send "overworld" to player
entries.name: World

entries.description: `true` or `false` (also `yes` and `no`).
entries.name: Boolean

entries.description: A chunk by its chunk coordinates, or the chunk a location is in. Can be stored and compared.
entries.example: send "%chunk of location(17, 64, -1)%"
entries.name: Chunk

entries.description: A color. Write a dye color (`red`, `light blue`), `rgb(r, g, b)` (0 to 255) or `color from hex "#rrggbb"`. Prints as `#rrggbb`, so `red value of` and the other channel expressions work on it.
entries.example:
send "%hex of rgb(255, 128, 0)%"
send "%red value of lime%"
entries.name: Color

entries.description: A moment in time, in UTC.
entries.name: Date

entries.description: An item type with an amount. Compares by type, not amount.
entries.name: Item

entries.description: A list parameter or result in a function. The element type is not checked.
entries.name: List

entries.description: A point with x, y, z and an optional world. Blocks are locations with whole numbers.
entries.name: Location

entries.description: About sixty types whose values are a fixed list of names: click type, damage cause, tree type, moon phase, spawn reason, potion effect type, and so on (full list on the page). Write a value as plain words, or make it from text with `parsed as`. A value equals text with the same name and works as a function parameter type.
entries.example:
function describe(c: click type) :: text:
    return "click: %{_c}%"
on join:
    send describe(shift left)
    set {_m} to "waxing crescent" parsed as moon phase
    send "%{_m}%"
entries.name: Named values

entries.description: Whole or decimal numbers, like `5` or `-2.5`.
entries.name: Number

entries.description: Any value. Checked when the line runs.
entries.name: Object

entries.description: An online player. Prints as the name.
entries.name: Player

entries.description: A rotation as w, x, y, z. Can be stored, compared and passed to functions.
entries.example:
set {q} to quaternion(1, 0, 0, 0)
send "%{q}%"
entries.name: Quaternion

entries.description: A first-in-first-out collection made from values. Prints its items; not saved in variables.json.
entries.example: send "%queue(1, 2, 3)%"
entries.name: Queue

entries.description: Text in quotes. A text slot accepts any value and prints it.
entries.name: Text

entries.description: A stretch of the day between two times, in ticks (0 is 6:00, 12000 is 18:00).
entries.example: send "%timeperiod(0, 12000)%"
entries.name: Timeperiod

entries.description: A length of time in milliseconds. One tick is 50 ms.
entries.name: Timespan

entries.description: A 3D direction or offset with x, y and z, like `vector(0, 1, 0)`.
entries.name: Vector

entries.description: A world. Equals text with its name.
entries.name: World

entries.description: The world border of a world, as a value you can keep in a variable. Size is read and set with the world border size forms.
entries.example: set {b} to world border of world of player
entries.name: World border

entries.description: The number without its minus sign.
entries.example: send "%abs(-3)%" to player
entries.name: abs

entries.description: Keeps a number between two bounds; median and product take numbers or a list.
entries.example: send "%clamp(15, 0, 10)%" to player
entries.name: clamp, median, product

entries.description: Text helpers: join values, format a number with a pattern, convert between bases, build a hex colour, parse a UUID.
entries.example: send "%toBase(255, 16)%" to player
entries.name: concat, formatNumber, toBase, fromBase, rgb, uuid

entries.description: Exponent, logarithms, roots and counting functions. `log` is base 10 unless a base is given.
entries.example: send "%combinations(5, 2)%" to player
entries.name: exp, ln, log, root, factorial, combinations, permutations, isNaN

entries.description: Rounds down, up, or to the nearest whole number.
entries.example: send "%round(2.6)%" to player
entries.name: floor / ceil / round

entries.description: Makes a location, optionally in a world.
entries.example: teleport player to location(0, 64, 0)
entries.name: location

entries.description: The smaller or bigger of two numbers.
entries.example: send "%max(3, 7)%" to player
entries.name: min / max

entries.description: Remainder, always 0 or more: `mod(-1, 5)` is 4.
entries.example: send "%mod(7, 3)%" to player
entries.name: mod

entries.description: Looks a player up by name or UUID, and gives the experience points a level needs.
entries.example: send "%calcExperience(10)%" to player
entries.name: player, offlinePlayer, calcExperience

entries.description: Defines a function callable from any script, as a value or on its own line. A script function wins over a built-in with the same name.
entries.example:
function coins(p: player) :: number:
    return {coins::%uuid of {_p}%} ? 0
on join:
    send "%coins(player)% coins" to player
entries.name: Script functions

entries.description: Trigonometry in degrees. The inverse functions return degrees.
entries.example: send "%sin(30)%" to player
entries.name: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, atan2

entries.description: Square root. A negative number is an error.
entries.example: send "%sqrt(16)%" to player
entries.name: sqrt
